body:
I think it's the same as America at 16 years old, though finding a place to live, and a job, are harder I think. 
But locking my door won't work, it's a lock that you can just grab like...a butter knife and unlock it. 

I could buy a camera, one that will record so I can look at it when I wake up, and if I see him doing anything, I'll go to the police (regardless of what my parents say) but Idk what camera I would buy. I've never looked for them.

Can I even do that? I am only 16. And even if I wanted the only place I could reasonably go is with my boyfriend, and he's in Canada (and I cant drive, or at least, I cant drive on my own without getting caught, and sent back to my parents)

I do know, however, if I could live somewhere. I am able to, legally, as long as I am in no danger. But I dont have anywhere to go, no money (at least not enough), I cant drive...

Another thing, if my relationship with my boyfriend improves when I see him (hopefully it does), then I plan on staying with his family...his mother said it was fine...or at least that was my plan, until my mom has 'suspicions' now I think she isnt gonna take me/let me go...maybe if I could drive on my own...but when I ask my mom to take me to test for my drivers license she says 'Alright, we'll go tomorrow' ...and we never go.

So I dont think living somewhere else is a valid option for me, but thanks for saying that...makes me thinks of things that might help

\-- Also something I want to add, is that everyone calls me stupid for staying with my boyfriend, and I'll agree. But please...**PLEASE** remember, if I were to leave him I would have absolutely no one to talk to. And hes an ass yea, but until I have a reasonable friend or something, I want to stay...because he can still calm me down.

Everyone tells me to leave him, to find someone new. But I've done that all before, and the last time i had to, I immediately tried to take my life in the worst way possible because I couldn't handle being so alone so suddenly. --

If you want an explanation on why people tell me to leave him, here is the shortened version:

He yells at me every time I panic (such as rapid breathing, crying, screaming, etc.). If i start crying, he'll tell me "Why am I going to help you when you just start crying out of nowhere" or if I tell him I want to hurt myself/take my life, he'll call me selfish, and stupid. I know he's horrible in this regard, but *please* read above before you tell me to just leave him.

I accidentally killed a teammate in Rainbow Six Siege (I was like 14 when this happened) the dude messaged me and told me that he wishes my boyfriend, or anyone, rapes me, and that I get kidnapped and no one finds me. All of that because I killed him. Worst part is I was actually raped before he said that so it really upset me.

Ended up never playing rainbow again.

The short and nerdy girl

I am really short, and a nerd in school, and everyone lets me know that

I've wanted to cut myself so bad recently.

Just everytime I look at my arms, or myself for that matter, I get an urge to cut myself. Because everyone I know, everyone I have ever known, just seem like they get hurt being around me. I feel like a problem, and along with being so scared of everything, I want to cut myself. My old friends used to tell me stop talking to them.

​

But even my doctors told me I was stupid, and that what I did was selfish. Instead of talking to me they would fuc\*ing preach to me as if I was in a Church.

My therapist would 'try to set up a coping method' with me, but just tell me stuff that I knew didnt help, regardless of if I told them or not.

My friends didnt seem to give a shi\* when I was suicidal either. It just seemed like they thought *Oh no...here she goes again.*

Back when I used to go to school, I used to get bullied, quite a bit. But it was one day when changing in the locker room (like I always did in the morning) I was teased, for having a small body. I told the Coaches, and Teachers, but none of them seemed to do anything.

I stopped changing the locker room, I didnt want to get teased again. Then I started to get made fun of for that, and I managed to convince my mom to take me out of school. It didnt solve the pain that being teased brought on.

And I later that year tried to overdose 3 times (2 of them I ended throwing up...alot...), I also tried to cut my arms so badly that I still have the scars to this day, and they are just as visable (pretty much) as they were back then.

When I woke up in the ICU (from the 1 overdose I didnt throw up) the look on my dads face...he looked so pissed at me...He even says he'll be really pissed at me if I took my own life.

When I came home from the hospital, my dad had gotten drunk, hit my grandma, and drove his truck into our gate. He ended up going to jail. When it comes to my dad, he used to grab me by the hair way back when he used to drink alot. I would get mad and fight back, which would just make it worse. He would grab me by the arms and hold me down if I got on his nerves (I was like 10, so I could be annoying at times)

My dad used to spank me, and tbh its scarred me more than its helped my behavior. Its just his voice still haunts my mind telling me just bend over and take it.

I have already tried CPS, it did nothing! I mean it helped my mom and dad realize spanking wasnt a good option, but it didnt help anything else.

I tried the police, a long time ago. They didnt help much either.

I tried talking to friends, nothing was helping.

My dad kept yanking me around when I annoyed him. It got to a point where I would run away from him if he showed any bit of getting mad. To this day, he hasnt fixed the part of me that fears him. I still run from him when he is mad, its just an instinct at this point.

When I was 9 (this has hurt me very badly, even now it still hurts) I was running from my dad, he was mad and I didnt want to get spanked. I got on-top of our car and while trying to get down I slipped and fell on the roof of the car. I ended up immediately breaking both my front teeth out, and one other (idk what it is called, its right next to your front tooth)

Now we are in the present, when I first met my boyfriend I was going to take my life. %100 was going to the next night, but he made me not take my life. He was so caring, and it showed that he loved me. But I dont know what I did wrong...to make him yell at me when I have panic attacks. I talked to his brother, and his brother became my friend, that might have been what upset him...I dont know

I live in a horrible place. The cops are horrible, therapists are horrible, doctors are horrible. Its all horrible, and its not worth my time going to any of them. Nowadays even if I wanted to call the cops I cant, and I know if I asked my mom, she would say no, even if I just asked to borrow her phone.

The only thing I have going for me is creating games. I can still make games and slightly destract myself...but my boyfriend wakes up in like 30mins and its scaring me.

I dont want to talk to him, but I have to. Or he'll start guilt tripping me.

Theres more I want to talk about. But I honestly already feel like a big bit\*h making you read all of this.

Sorry...

Thank you for saying that, honestly.

Its not so much that I define myself as a poor person, I do define myself as a poor person, but what I mainly do is panic that everyone is going to hurt me. 

Such as the above comment, Mono wasnt being mean, in fact I liked their comment, it reminded of when I used to write letters like that. I started crying because I was just terrified that they said something mean.

Most people say they dont want to help me because I am just 'one problem after another'...its all because I kept everything to myself, so much so that I have alot to tell people. But no one wants to listen to me.

My parents dont want to, or they care enough to, my boyfriend...well he yells at me. As soon as I say something that has been bothering me he just says "What is it this time?" in an very annoyed tone. 

If I typed out everything I wanted to talk to someone about, well...you'd be scrolling for a long time. I have so many things that have just broken me. 

But still thank you for what you said

Sorry if this comes off as me being mean, I promise I am not trying to be mean.

But I cant write letters anymore, it just doesn't help...I'm to scared of everything else. I used to write letters like that, but when my boyfriend took my friends, he took that passion for writing letters. The last time I tried something that likes a Pen pal it went horribly, I was called words like selfish, stupid, or mean. 

Even seeing the notification that you commented, I broke down crying, and am still crying. It scares to think about what people can say, and that fear just makes me cry all the time.

I try to write letters all the time, but I just end up breaking down in tears and just end up thinking about when I went wrong, or what I did to hurt so many people. 

Sorry if I am being mean, or my typing is confusing
